name: surprise
quote: I didn't expect you to be there!
description: A perception that what just happened that was counter to expectations in some way. Whether the surprise is positive or negative depends on the context.
perceptions: Something happened that directly conflicts with an expectation.
results: Surprise will quickly change into some other experience such as delight or anger. It may raise your energy level into excitement, or maybe not.

guidance.description: Surprise is a basic capacity of the mind that's a 'gateway' sensation to many other experiences and is important in directing our attention.

comparisons.description: Surprise is a violation of your prediction. The relevance of the violation may lead to the higher energy level of excitement.

examples: The kids knocked the vase off the shelf, which crashed loudly.
I'd expected the trip to be good, but not that good.

variations.name: novelty
variations.description: A perception that what just happened was new a type of experience where there weren't previously expectations. Whether the novelty is positive or negative depends on the context.
perceptions: Something happened where I didn't have a definite expectation.
results: Novelty will quickly change into some other experience such as delight or disgust. It may raise your energy level into excitement, or maybe not.

commentaries.quote: When the unexpected happens, there's generally a moment of confusion while you try to figure out what happened. In a very short time, you can go from surprise to fear to relief to joy.
Nobody is exempt from the surprises of life!
Surprise is a double-edged sword, dipped in delight on one side and disappointment on the other.
commentaries.attribution: Tania Luna and Leeann Renninger in 'Surprise'

commentaries.quote: Surprise is God's way of saying 'hello.' The response is optional.
The moments of happiness we enjoy take us by surprise. It is not that we seize them, but that they seize us.
Men desire novelty to such an extent that those who are doing well wish for a change as much as those who are doing badly.
